mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies and 29-degree temperatures at Verona Community Park, with a crisp feel of 23 degrees under a First Quarter moon.

City news this week includes several public notices for the November 2026 elections and ongoing review of development projects, such as the site plan for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park. Additionally, residents are reminded that the Municipal Court is available to handle citations, though many can be resolved online or via mail.

There is a great lineup of local activities starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge with trivia nights at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's, followed by live music later in the week.

Regarding local public safety, the Verona Police Department reported a notable incident on October 25 where officers arrested a man for O W I after locating him in a vehicle that had been stopped at an intersection for 20 minutes.
If you are craving something sweet, Culver's is serving up Chocolate Volcano today. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM for all your dairy treat needs.
